name: X-23 StarWorker
description: The X-23 StarWorker was an intra-system space barge produced by the starship manufacturing corporation Incom Corporation. It was capable of carrying up to 5,000 metric tons of cargo in its 2,000 cubic meter bay.

data.name: X-23 StarWorker
data.capacity: 2,000 cubic meters with a maximum mass of 5,000 metric tons
